profile.body: I studied a wide range of design-related fields in college, where I mastered the fundamentals of various expressive techniques. During that time, I became fascinated with coding and taught myself to deepen my skills in the field. Driven by a desire to tackle community-based challenges and explore the true potential of design, I worked as a coder and designer at TETUSIN DESIGN Inc. for two and a half years starting in 2023. Currently, I am interested in developing web systems and applications, and I am studying diligently with the goal of becoming a software engineer and full-stack engineer.

profile.skill_dd_high: I offer semantic coding that takes SEO and accessibility into account. My CSS design follows object-oriented principles and is based on PRECSS. I use jQuery for features such as hamburger menus and display animations.
profile.skill_dd_mid: I have practical experience with these tools, but I’d like to further hone my skills. I use PHP to build custom WordPress themes, and Git/GitHub for personal version control.
profile.skill_dd_low: These are skills I am currently working hard to master through personal projects. This site was built using Tailwind, Next.js.
profile.tool_dd_high: I can implement designs from any design tool into code. I primarily use Windsurf as my development environment. Additionally, thanks to my experience with remote work at my previous job, I am able to communicate smoothly via chat and online platforms.
profile.tool_dd_mid: I have practical experience using these tools, but I’d like to hone my skills further. I have experience developing custom templates for Shopify, STUDIO, and BASE.
profile.tool_dd_low: These are skills I am currently working hard to master through independent projects. They are implemented on this website.
